caption: The drawing depicts a stylized bird, possibly an eagle, with its wings spread wide. The bird is primarily yellow with green spots scattered across its body and wings. Its tail feathers and the lower part of its wings feature blue shading. The bird has a green patch around its neck and head, and a small blue circle for its eye. Extending from either side of the bird's head are two large green leaves, each with a prominent central vein and yellow edges. Below the bird, there is a green base with angular and rough-edged surfaces. In front of this base, there is an oval-shaped object colored yellow with green spots. To the left, a cylindrical column is visible, decorated with alternating diagonal blue and green stripes. The background is off-white, and the objects are outlined faintly, giving them definition against the plain backdrop. The artist's signature, "MAJEL G. CLAFLIN - TAOS - NM-12," is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Painted Wooden Sconce
